entry.title: Wash a cloth together
entry.summary: Davies describes washing cloths with an adult as a chance to repeat scrubbing, washing, and cleanup movements. One part of the work can hold a child’s interest.
entry.cue: Your child wants to scrub a cloth or repeat part of washing it.
detail: The appendix example has two tubs on a table, a small scrub board, a bar of soap in a dish, a jug, and baskets beside the table. An apron, drying mitt, and hand-drying cloth complete her setup.

Show slowly and help where needed. A child may keep returning to one movement rather than finish the whole sequence. Davies advises limiting what is put out and stopping before the shared work becomes overwhelming.
